name: Captain Aldis
title: Warden of the North Gate
examine: Stone house, stone gaze. The North Gate has opinions and she is all of them.
lines: The gate is open. Whether you should walk through it is a different question.
North of here the land stops being polite. I post the truth on this wall and let people spend it how they like.
Hask taught me to read a road. I taught him a sergeant's whistle carries further than a sergeant's opinion.
